book.name: JONI
book.title: Jisesi Kalaestida gala lalo Jonima luhuwa jibo

content: Jisesima helenebokuti sinaibo.

Sadeu maya go lo mikalo molamiyoko, Magadala numutokati mena Mele maya ono eba maya mudakolo wiye. Woko mudaibo maya, ehada numuto ateto ehada napa moli li li-minabo ehada maya ipisiki li huli-minayoko mudaiye.
Sakoko lolosa jeko woko Saimoni Pitako nemoko maya muda-lelokoko sa-loko lo limiye: We napatemidana onola maya alo liki wikae. Nakahaukama moli-minabo ne. Lemoya ma muda-elamune.
Loko lokaiyoko, Pitako nemoko maya aya ono ebatoka maya woiye.
Anuloka lolosa jeko woko nemo maya Pitada huloetokoko omutoko woko ono alelo maya hetokoko,
awa heko mudaobo maya, lawo-lawo nala jebo nesago neyoko mudaoboya, aya ehada numuku maya yowamoe.
Sakoyoko, Saimoni Pita maya alikaya nisekoko aya ehada numuku maya yoweko mudaibo maya lawo-lawo sese abomago neyoko,
madonalo ukulo lawo-lawo wasa jebo maya aitoya elewekeko moloneyoko mudaiye.
Sa-iyoko, nemo omutoko nisoboma neboya alikaya ayau maya yowekoko aya nesago neyoko mudakoko aloya sinoko wokaiye loko elewole oko nata koe.
Hapa yeikalaya monoka bukugu Jisesima helenetibokuti aku sinoko yowitibo ne loko nebo ga maya ele wehe lamune.
Sa-okoko lemo maya aku le wili jeko numutoka maya woiye.
Jisesima Magadala numutokati mena Mele neboto soto pibo.
Wokoiyoko, Magadala numutokati mena Melema ayalo maya ale apilaloka minoko wije nama leko nebototiya awa heko aya aleu maya nomudaiyoko,
okananipoki we lowe maya Jisesida ale jitabo ale epalo maya ukulo nesago olo jikiki esenipo hiki minaiyoko mudaidonebo ne. Makoyamoya madonaloka maya nebo ne. Makoya ilaloka nebo ne.
Sakiya minaidanaki, mena yamalae, emoya nenahamuya wije noane, liki laiyoko, maya menamamo edimoya nenaha iye, nemo we napaneda onola maya liki wikayoko nakahaloka liki wahe loko ohu nojeko noloe.
Loko lokoko mino wili jeko mudaibo maya, Jisesima neyoko mudaibo neboya, okepala maya muda wehe lamibo ne.

Muda wehe lamiyoko, Jisesimamo loka oetoko mena yamalae, ekahidamu ohu jeko moneko wije nama nolene. Loko loka iyoko, emoya ya yuhau yowanu lekaka we maya nehe loko sa-loko lo miye: We lalo nesa yamalae, emoya onowa maya leko woko aito ebakuka molo-minatadawoya, lo nimideko leko wetuwe.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo Mele liyoko, emo maya wili jeko Juda gaukatiya lapuniyo loko, lemo gateukatiya monoka ujapalo we yamalae loko libo ne.

Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo nemoya ahonetoka owaha yowamoyo, napusa jamoko, woko unamotanele yuhasida maya nemo ahone maya edimo ahotipoe, ito nemo Omaine maya edimo Omaitipo nebotoka yowekoloyo, lo bo loko lo miye.
Loko lo mekaiyoko, Mele Magadala numutokati menamamo aku le wili jeko woko Jisesida unala ipalale yuhasida maya sa-loko lo limiye: Nemoya we napate maya muda-eloyoko, sa-loko lo nimiye, loko liye.
Jisesima unala ipalale yuha minabotoka soto pibo.

Loko lokaiyoko, Sadeu maya lubu jekaiyoko, lemo unala ipalale yuha maya Juda wewenasida ujapa wenipolemuya olite lemekaiyoko nenako, anu vokoko numuku maya yoweko minuniyoko, Jisesimamo luwawateu maya sinonedanaki sa-loko lo limiye: Huluya edimotoka minadeyo.
Loko lokoko ade lowe maya lilipeko lohana maya lilipiyoko, unala ipalale yuha maya we napate maya muda-elokoko muluteu lalo elune.
Sa-okuniyoko, akuya sa-loko lo limiye: Hulu maya edimotoka minadeyo. Ahonekaho noli hibomidana oko edimoya doli nohoe.
Loko lokoko, epa mutiwa lemeko sa-loko liye: Omaimidana weuna oluho maya lilo.
Sa-ikadeko, wewena maya lahelamibo nesamu liki hulataboya suwetiyo. Sa-ikiki liki hulamitabo maya aha minakolaiye, loko liye. 23 Mat 16:19; Mat 18:18
Tomasiya Jisesima aku sinaibokumu elewole oko ata kamibo.
Iwete makoya uliwa Tomasiyo loko uliwa makoya Lobe-Oluhoe loko nebo weya eba makomalo neyoko, Jisesima sinokoko niseko lemotoka soto piye.

Soto pekaiyoko, lemo sa-loko wetome oko lo mune: Lemo we napate maya lomudaloti muda-elokune. Loko lokuniyoko, Tomasimamo neimonekaho adelau hulala maya mudamoko ayauya nadeloti leko elamoko, ito lohanaloka hulala maya nadeloti leko elamoko maya, gatipo watiya ne loko lametuwe.

Loko lokoko neyoko, Sade makoya alili okaiyoko, lemo unala ipalale yuha maya aya Tomasimakiya numuda makomauya minudanaki, anu maya voko etoha okoko ulau maya minune. Sako minuniyoko, Jisesima luwakuti maya soto pekoko sa-loko lo limiye: Huluya edimotoka minadeyo.
Loko lokoko Tomasida maya sa-loko lo miye: Adeloti yaitaya nade hulaneloka maya leko mudao. Ito adeka hulo moloko lohaneloka maya leko elo. Sakoko ataka lowe kamoko elewole oko ata makoko ko.
Loko liyoko, Tomasimamo we napanemae ito Omainemae, loko liye.
Loko liyoko, Jisesimamo emoya olotiya muda-nelokoko elewole oko ata kekane. Nemodaya muda-nelamiki elewole iki data kikaka niabo wewenamuya nelone, loko liye.
Jonikaho luhuwa jibomidana monawa.
Ito Jisesikaho unala ipalale yuha lomudalo maya oliwaki nesa elewoleya lolo ibo maloka maya luhuwa je suwamoboya,

maloka maya luhuwa jobolawaya lepiki elikiki Jisesidamuya lahelamibo nesauti lilimitiye loko lo mololetaibo we Omaimidana ipalae liki emokumuya elewole iki data ki miniki elewole depa mutiwa maya litae loko jeminobo ne.
